completion_scope.included: Continuous day/night first-run completion itinerary from 6/2 through 10/25, covering all 14 Follower R8 bonds, quests and bounties, all five max Royal Virtues, books, debates, cooking, key towns/scenic views, Gold Beetles, and time-limited missables. Dungeon/travel scheduling and downtime activities must fit a real single-run calendar.
completion_scope.excluded: Repeated grinding, arbitrary random drops and NG+-exclusive superboss/achievement; true NG+ obligations appear only in clearly optional appendix. This guide does not promise every item/inventory-perfection possible under mutually exclusive outcomes.
completion_scope.progress: Expanded scope approved in PR #120 owner comment https://github.com/kanjieater/VN-Guide/pull/120#issuecomment-6956649441. Original six routes were follower milestones; sequential calendar conversion and independent review pending.

disagreements: A labels several Rank 8 entries as RANK4; B+E agree these are rank 8. A implies Maria paintings are mandatory; B+E describe Maria's rank-ups through conversations and Virtue ranks; scenic paintings should be treated as optional gifts. A and E map some Neuras relics to different rank indices: E confirms any of the six relics may be turned in out of order for ranks 2–7, so the guide lists locations without a forced hand-in order. Some earliest-day indications in A conflict with B's 2-day spacing; B and E are used for cadence and quest prerequisites. Character sections are chronological windows, not fixed appointment dates. English localized and Japanese quest names are linked where directly verified. Accuracy review A1 (2026-11-17): GameWith's Catherina R2 condition explicitly specifies outgoing travel from Martira to Great Sandworm's Nest; Gamecap only confirms the battle after July 2, so corrected the previously incorrect incoming-leg assertion. A2: Gamecap's Junah prerequisite 枯れ薬の材料を探せ is corroborated by GameWith's dedicated quest page and independent Japanese quest guides (Kamigame and Chucco); added the preceding request to the executable chain. GameWith's summary follower table omitted the prerequisite, but its quest-specific page states it. SCOPE UPDATE 2026-11-17: Owner explicitly requested a Persona-style spoiler-light day-by-day first-run calendar in PR #120 issuecomment-6956649441. The 2024 independent JP schedules (アルテマ, ゲーマーの備忘録) choose different dungeon dates and day/night activities but share a feasible first-run max-Follower/content goal; GameWith provides another 2026-maintained monthly calendar. Different recommendations are swappable, never presented as hard quest windows without corroboration. A date-specific bond plan from the original GamerB schedule must be checked against actual rank prerequisites, calendar-time costs and early dungeon state. PowerPyx and RPG Site independently confirm most first-run content is doable with only the NG+ superboss beyond the first playthrough. This expanded new content invalidates both structural and accuracy PASS for all modified sections; keep reviewed:false.
